photography.rightsBoundary: Attribution is not permission. AVPN and Prague City Tourism images retain an explicit not-independently-cleared statement under the existing EA moderate-risk policy. Expressly prohibited Museum der Dinge and Yamamoto imagery was rejected. Open licences, creator, direct source and share-alike obligations are retained for sixteen images.
photography.creditFormat: Image: author / source ↗, opening the direct source in a new tab
photography.visualRefinement: The first Wellington cityscape lost its cable car in the desktop crop. Final visual review selected Heidi Meudt's December 2025 portrait. Rautis bead painting is explicitly production context, not a visitor painting lesson. Historical Yamamoto tools are not mislabelled as the current brush-based class. The Met architectural object's medieval date is not used as a photographic date.

guides.title: Build a Montréal lunch at Jean-Talon Market
guides.eaValue: Choose a few things to eat in Little Italy and let the labels, seasons and stallholders complicate your first idea of Québec.

guides.title: Stretch the dough before tasting Naples
guides.eaValue: Mix, stretch and dress pizza at AVPN's Naples school, then sit down to understand what your hands just attempted.

guides.title: Choose Lisbon by the fish inside the tin
guides.eaValue: Visit Conserveira de Lisboa's counter and choose by species and preparation before choosing by the wrapper.

guides.title: Turn loose glass beads into a Poniklá ornament
guides.eaValue: Watch how hollow beads are made at Rautis, then assemble a small ornament from prepared pieces in its public creative workshop.

guides.title: Give a Prague marionette its first movement
guides.eaValue: Build a character from prepared wooden parts at Marionety Truhlář, then discover what changes when it hangs from strings.

guides.title: Draw Kyoto in wax before the indigo arrives
guides.eaValue: Trace a design with hot wax at Yamamoto's Kyoto studio and follow what the dye leaves white.

guides.title: Let Paris rise around a canal boat
guides.eaValue: Travel through the Canal Saint-Martin's locks and covered Bastille section, where the city changes height around you.

guides.title: Read Melbourne from a City Circle tram
guides.eaValue: Use the free heritage Route 35 to connect street names, corners and landmarks at the pace of an ordinary tram ride.

guides.title: Rise above Wellington in a working cable car
guides.eaValue: Climb from Lambton Quay to Kelburn in a few minutes, then let the harbour view explain the hill you just travelled.

guides.title: Find a Victorian painter's world behind a London door
guides.eaValue: Enter Leighton House and move from a London street into a home built around an artist's work and collected objects.

guides.title: Look out from inside Rome's city wall
guides.eaValue: Enter the Museo delle Mura at Porta San Sebastiano and discover a city boundary from the space within it.

guides.title: Meet Berlin in a cabinet of ordinary things
guides.eaValue: Look through the Museum der Dinge's open storage and give a familiar household object more attention than its designer expected.

guides.title: Find a Manhattan pause between medieval columns
guides.eaValue: Head to The Met Cloisters in Upper Manhattan and let a courtyard change the pace of a museum visit.

guides.title: Walk into Lisbon's unheated garden
guides.eaValue: Step from Parque Eduardo VII into Estufa Fria and follow filtered light through a different kind of city garden.

guides.title: Give Copenhagen an hour beneath the winter-garden dome
guides.eaValue: Include the Glyptotek's palm-filled Winter Garden in a museum visit and make a deliberate pause part of looking at art.

guides.title: Hear Ghent played from above the square
guides.eaValue: Be near the Belfry on Sunday morning and listen for a live player in a sound that usually seems to belong to the city itself.

guides.title: Let an archive film interrupt a Dublin lunchtime
guides.eaValue: Take a public cinema seat at the Irish Film Institute and give a short archival programme part of your Temple Bar afternoon.

guides.title: Give Amsterdam a seat beside the jazz stage
guides.eaValue: Choose a live BIMHUIS concert by what you want to hear and let the room become an evening's destination.
